note: Ambiguity is named a positive characteristic of the essence of metaphysics, neither a whim nor a fault of philosophy.
The dual semblance (Schein) of being science and of being worldview-proclamation; philosophy looks like both and is neither.
The general ambiguity becomes MORE acute here-and-now (philosophy as examination subject), not less — §5 intensifies §4.
The teacher's undesired authority persuades only so long as he is not understood; once understood the authority collapses.
The 'decide on factual grounds of proof' reply is itself challenged: perhaps what is provable is only what is essentially irrelevant.
Academy inscription (no entry without geometry) marshalled as evidence of the semblance that philosophical truth = mathematical certainty.
Descartes wants to furnish philosophical truth with the character of mathematical truth; Leibniz: without mathematics no ground of metaphysics.
Mathematical knowledge is the emptiest and least binding as regards human substance, so cannot be the measure for philosophical knowledge.
The formal-contradiction objection is the 'much more acute' counter; Heidegger concedes its surface force then voids it as empty and non-binding.
Aristotle, Descartes, Leibniz, Hegel 'refuted by a doctoral candidate' — the catastrophes attending philosophy-as-absolute-science.
Philosophy's truth is essentially that of human Dasein and 'in part rooted in the fate (Geschick) of Dasein' — the chapter's keystone resolution of the ambiguity.
Because truth is rooted in Dasein's fate, everything 'should start to vacillate'; philosophy is the opposite of all comfort — turbulence (Wirbel).
Philosophia as love-of / homesickness-for must maintain itself in nothingness, in finitude — God does not philosophize.
The perilous neighbourhood of supreme uncertainty is sustained as terror (Schrecken) in which we must 'hold out'.
In philosophizing the Da-sein in man launches the attack (Angriff) upon man; man as a whole is in the grip of an attack.
The 'pessimistic' verdict stems from the normal human's eternal average (petty pleasures, shallow fears, smug comforts) — an illegitimate judge of philosophizing.
Heraclitus DK 108: the to sophon is 'separated off from everything else' (= absolutum) — philosophy is autonomous, stands on its own.
Plato (Republic): the philosophizing human is awake (hypar), the non-philosophizing — incl. the scientist — asleep (onar); only philosophizing is wakeful Dasein.
There are sciences only because there is philosophy; philosophizing lies prior to every occupation and constitutes the fundamental occurrence (Grundgeschehen) of Dasein.
As autonomous Grundgeschehen that lets Da-sein first become what it can be, philosophizing grounds the Part-One demand that an attunement be AWAKENED.

ANTICIPATORY-APPLICATION: the affective register (Schrecken/Angriff/Wirbel) installed here is the correlate against which profound boredom's stillness (low-arousal 'zombie stare') reads as privation.
